name: ATC_ECC_IMPEXP_JOB
description: This table store the details of COMMS NPI ECC import jobs

columns.name: IMPEXP_JOB_ID
columns.description: Unique rowid of the import or export job

columns.name: JOB_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for an import or export job

columns.name: JOB_TYPE
columns.description: A String.Indicates the type of the job like import or export.

columns.name: INCLUDE_REFERENCE
columns.description: A String.Comma separated values indicating the embedded references to be exported.

columns.name: CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: A string. Indicates the format of the data.The default value is application/json.

columns.name: PATH
columns.description: A string. URL of the root resource where the content is imported or exported

columns.name: QUERY_FILTER
columns.description: A string. Used to scope the exported data. (identical to GET filter construct using target ID as base)

columns.name: GEN_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Identifier used to store generic job name.

columns.name: GEN_JOB_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Column to store generic job description.

columns.name: EVENT_NAME
columns.description: Column used to store the event name details.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: A string. Status of the job (not started, running, succeeded, failed)

columns.name: URL
columns.description: A string. URL of the file containing the data to be imported or exported.

columns.name: IS_DIRECTORY
columns.description: A string. Y or N. Indicates if the output URL is a directory.

columns.name: COMPLETION_DATE
columns.description: A date time (DateTime). Date at which the job was completed.

columns.name: ERROR_DETAIL_LOG
columns.description: A string. Reason for failure if status is failed.

columns.name: PARENT_JOB_ID
columns.description: A string. Id of the corresponding parent Job if any.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: A date field. Represents the start date of the job.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: A string. Id of the item being imported by the job.

columns.name: ITEM_NAME
columns.description: A string. Name of the item being imported by the job.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A string. Description of the item being imported by the job.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: A string. Type of the item being imported by the job.

columns.name: IS_ITEM_BUNDLED
columns.description: "true" or "f;ase" string-  Identifies the item being imported by the job is bundled or not.

columns.name: JOB_PROGRESS_CODE
columns.description: A number. This field represents the progress code of job.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the record is deleted or not

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
